Rule: entity-evaluations where exact and approx agree on whether the rule is active.

panels.title: VictoriaMetrics vs ASAPQuery-backend
VictoriaMetrics, which keeps every raw sample, vs ASAPQuery-backend planned to keep none: writes, memory, disk and query latency
panels.description: VictoriaMetrics answers are the exact arm, ASAPQuery-backend answers the approx arm. One sender writes both in time order; at each evaluation time it makes the samples written so far visible (a watermark for ASAPQuery-backend, a flush for VictoriaMetrics) and asks the queries due then, one instant query each. Write seconds include the visibility calls. Peak resident bytes and CPU seconds cover the whole process; disk bytes is the data directory at the end, and ASAPQuery-backend keeps everything in memory.
